definitions: A building with sails that turn in the wind and generate power to grind grain or pump water.
A toy consisting of a stick with a revolving vane or vanes at one end, designed to spin in the wind.
An exercise in which the body is bent forward and the arms are swung in a circular motion.
examples: The old windmill stood on the hill.
Children played with a colourful windmill.
She performed a windmill during her workout.
